items.q: Joe Thomas, I met him and Earl (Al)Carruthers.

ctx.x: trouble. I said, "Well, I can't make any between you and (?). Earl." He said, He made it (?). "Well, have him call me." /... I think it was around $100. He just wanted to hear Earl play.
I see. It was just more or less personal ...
